The Load Data screen

Source: R/wizard-upload_page.R
cd_upload_data_ui.Rd

The whole Load Data screen of a Countdown app: the page header, with its help button, and the Load Data wizard with all seven steps. The server starts every step's server, builds the steps' pages and hands them to wizard_steps_server(). The screen is the same for every app. What differs between apps (the fields of the National Rates step and the reference-data upload zones) comes from the app's options(cd2030.wizard = ...), which must be set before the screen is used (see cd_wizard_config()). cd_app() uses this screen unless the app passes its own upload_ui and upload_server.

Usage

cd_upload_data_ui(id, i18n, is_electron = FALSE)

cd_upload_data_server(id, i18n, cdsuite_file, active)

Arguments

id

The module's id.

i18n

The app's translator (a shiny.i18n translator), used for every label.

is_electron

TRUE when the app was started with a file to load (the desktop app), FALSE (the default) when the user picks the file in the page. The ui function does not use it: the server works it out from cdsuite_file.

cdsuite_file

The path of the file the app was started with, a string, or NA_character_ when it was started without one. With a path, the file is loaded at startup and the Upload Data step shows no upload zone.

active

A reactive that returns TRUE while the Load Data screen is the page shown.

Value

cd_upload_data_ui() returns the UI as Shiny tags: the page header and the wizard. cd_upload_data_server() returns a list with two elements:

  • cache: a reactive value that holds the dataset, a CacheConnection, or NULL when none is loaded;

  • requires_walkthrough: a reactive value that is TRUE when the wizard must be walked through step by step, and FALSE when a saved dataset (.rds) was loaded.

Details

The steps and their modules, in wizard order: Upload Data (upload_box_ui() and reference_estimates_ui() in one card), Data Quality (data_quality_ui()), Survey Files (survey_upload_ui()), National Rates (national_rates_ui()), Shapefile (shapefile_step_ui()), Map Survey Files (map_survey_ui()) and Map Shapefile Names (map_shapefile_ui()).

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# the app describes its part of the wizard once, before the screen is used
options(cd2030.app_group = "rmncah", cd2030.wizard = list(national_rates_groups = list(
  cd_wizard_field_group("title_upload_group_maternal", "sub_upload_group_maternal",
    cd_wizard_survey_field("anc4_prop", "anc4", "title_upload_anc4_survey"),
    cd_wizard_national_rate_fields()
  )
)))

# in the app's ui
cd_upload_data_ui("upload_data", i18n = i18n)

# in the app's server: the dataset every page reads
loaded <- cd_upload_data_server("upload_data", i18n, NA_character_,
  active = reactive(identical(input$tabs, "upload_data"))
)
cache <- loaded$cache

# cd_app() does both when it is given the pair
cd_app(app_name, app_version, theme, nav_sections, registry, i18n, language, selected_file,
  upload_ui = cd_upload_data_ui, upload_server = cd_upload_data_server
)
} # }
